subject: Future Tech
title: Mass Customization
description: Learn Mass Customization in one minute.

hook.text: Traditional factories make millions of identical products.

buildup.text: Adidas uses 3D printing to create midsoles tuned to each runner's weight, gait, and foot shape. Every pair is unique.

discovery.text: Align Technology prints over half a million custom Invisalign dental aligners every day.

twist.text: Customization was always expensive because retooling molds is costly.

climax.text: Hearing aids, eyeglass frames, and prosthetic limbs are all shifting to mass customization through 3D printing.

punchline.text: One printer, a million unique products. No molds required.

quiz.question: How many custom Invisalign aligners does Align Technology print daily?
